hero.title: DermaScan AI V3
hero.subtitle: Clinical Decision Support for the Modern Dermatologist.
hero.description: Fusing visual pattern recognition with biological metadata to provide explainable, safe, and accurate skin lesion triage.

problem.heading: The Diagnostic Gap
problem.text: In many parts of the world, a severe shortage of dermatologists leads to delayed diagnosis of skin cancers, costing lives. General practitioners need reliable second opinions to triage effectively.

solution.heading: Multi-Modal Intelligence
solution.text: Unlike traditional models that only look at pixels, DermaScan AI fuses high-resolution dermoscopic imagery with critical patient metadata (age, sex, anatomical site) to mirror how a real clinician makes a diagnosis.

features.title: Multi-Modal AI Architecture
features.text: DermaScan AI fuses visual patterns from dermoscopic images with biological metadata (age, sex, anatomical site) to make a holistic prediction, just like a dermatologist considers patient context.

features.title: EfficientNetB4 Backbone
features.text: We use EfficientNetB4, a state-of-the-art convolutional neural network pre-trained on ImageNet, providing a powerful 1792-dimensional image embedding while remaining computationally efficient.

features.title: Grad-CAM Explainability
features.teaser: See exactly what the AI sees.
features.text: Grad-CAM highlights the image regions the AI focused on. This builds clinician trust and helps identify if the model is looking at the right area.

features.title: Clinical Risk Mapping
features.text: Predictions are grouped into clinically meaningful categories with corresponding urgency levels and recommendations, making the output directly actionable.

features.title: Safety Net Threshold
features.text: If the AI is less than 60% confident, it does not guess. Instead, it advises consulting a dermatologist, preventing potentially dangerous misdiagnoses.

features.title: Offline Capability
features.text: The entire system runs locally on a standard laptop. No internet connection is needed, making it suitable for rural clinics and privacy-sensitive environments.

features.title: PDF Report Generation
features.text: A comprehensive clinical report (PDF) is generated with a single click, containing the image, heatmap, differential diagnosis, and disclaimer — ready for the patient's file.

features.title: Patient Metadata Integration
features.text: Incorporating patient context (age, sex, lesion location) enables the model to adjust its prediction based on known epidemiological risk factors.

features.title: Demo Mode
features.text: A special Demo Mode temporarily lowers the confidence threshold, allowing the AI to provide concrete answers during presentations while still clearly indicating its experimental nature.

features.title: Real-World Performance
features.text: Evaluated on 3,800 unseen test images, DermaScan AI achieves 65.7% overall accuracy, with excellent recall on vascular lesions and a robust safety net for challenging cases.

footer.disclaimer: ⚠️ ACADEMIC PROTOTYPE – Not for clinical use. This tool is designed to assist, not replace, a medical professional.
